heroIntro: Original flash designs and custom pieces drawn by hand. Queer, melancholic, slightly strange - made to live on skin.
flashIntro: Choose a design, select a size, then book a date. Prices shown are indicative and may vary slightly depending on placement.
customText: Custom projects are welcome. Send the idea, placement, approximate size and any references that help communicate the mood.
infoText: Paris. A deposit is required to secure every appointment and is deducted from the final tattoo price.
